proposals.before: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Li, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
proposals.after: On renchen day Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin was made to administer Southern Court great king affairs and promoted yuyue; Yelü Mu, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made Northern Court privy commissioner; Northern Court associate privy commissioner Yelü Telidi was made administrator of Northern Court privy affairs; Left yilibi Yelü Shiqian was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

decisions.reason: s0006 names 耶律霂; 霂 is Mu, so replacing the false given name Li is required and the rest of the sentence is unchanged.
s0013 names the jinshi 劉瓘; 瓘 is Guan, not Jin, so the idiomatic personal name must be corrected.
The same unit’s literal field also reads 劉瓘 as Liu Jin; Guan matches the Chinese given name.
s0024 begins 癸未; that sexagenary day is guiwei, whereas guimao would be 癸卯.
Literal likewise mistook 癸未 for guimao; guiwei is the correct day name.
出知興中府事 records an outward appointment to administer Xingzhong, not dismissal from that prefectural post.
Literal shares the same error on 出知; “sent out as administrator” restores the appointment sense.
s0038 is dated 癸未; guiwei is correct and guimao is a different day (癸卯).
Literal likewise needs guiwei for 癸未 rather than guimao.
出為武定軍節度使 is an outward appointment as Wuding Army military commissioner, not dismissal from that office.
Literal repeats the false “dismissed” reading of 出為; “sent out as” matches the Chinese.
諸帝在時生辰及忌日 means the various emperors’ lifetime birthdays and death anniversaries, not rites held “while emperors lived.”
黍所定升斗 are sheng and dou measures fixed by the millet standard; “Taixing” invents a person absent from the Chinese.
Literal invents the same nonexistent Taixing; millet-standard sheng and dou restore 黍所定升斗.

decisions.after: On yimao day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered Huage to tutor Prince of Liang Yanxi and promoted him Grand General of the Jinwu Guard.
decisions.reason: 加金吾衛大將軍 does promote Huage, but 金吾衛 is the Jinwu Guard, not a “Golden Crow Guard”; keep the promotion on Huage with the correct office name.
s0151 names 杜公謂; 謂 is wei, so Gongwei replaces the false Gongyu.
Literal shares the Gongyu misreading of 公謂; Gongwei is required.
裨將老古金吾衛大將軍 separates personal name Laogu from Grand General of the Jinwu Guard; “Golden Crow” and “Laogu Defender” misparse the office.
